```{r}
#| label: inject-bivariate-data
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
if (explorer_ready) {
  # Palette Stevens 3x3 (croisement terciles X × Y)
  biv_palette <- c(
    "#E8E8E8", "#B0D5DF", "#64ACBE",   # ligne Y1 (bas)
    "#E4ACAC", "#AD9EA5", "#627F8C",   # ligne Y2
    "#C85A5A", "#985356", "#574249"    # ligne Y3 (haut)
  )

  # Variables disponibles dans le merged + libellés humains + groupes
  biv_vars <- tibble::tribble(
    ~field,              ~label,                  ~group,
    "elec_pct_nfp",      "% NFP",                 "Élections",
    "elec_pct_ens",      "% Ensemble",            "Élections",
    "elec_pct_rn",       "% RN",                  "Élections",
    "elec_pct_lr",       "% LR",                  "Élections",
    "elec_pct_divers",   "% Divers",              "Élections",
    "elec_abstention",   "Abstention",            "Élections",
    "elec_marge",        "Marge vainqueur",       "Élections",
    "dvf_prix_app",      "Prix m² Appartement",   "Immobilier",
    "dvf_prix_mai",      "Prix m² Maison",        "Immobilier",
    "air_qual",          "Indice ATMO global",    "Qualité air",
    "air_no2",           "NO₂",                   "Qualité air",
    "air_o3",            "O₃",                    "Qualité air",
    "air_pm10",          "PM₁₀",                  "Qualité air",
    "air_pm25",          "PM₂.₅",                 "Qualité air",
    "ctx_log_pop",       "log₁₀(population)",     "Démographie",
    "ctx_log_inscrits",  "log₁₀(inscrits)",       "Démographie",
    "revenu_median",     "Revenu médian €",       "Revenus",
    "revenu_d1",         "1ᵉʳ décile revenu €",   "Revenus",
    "revenu_d9",         "9ᵉ décile revenu €",    "Revenus",
    "gini",              "Indice de Gini",        "Revenus",
    "pct_imposes",       "% ménages imposés",     "Revenus",
    "part_prestations",  "Part prestations (%)",  "Revenus",
    "del_total_pour_mille","Délinq. totale ‰",    "Sécurité",
    "del_cambriolages",  "Cambriolages ‰",        "Sécurité",
    "del_violences_sex", "Violences sex. ‰",      "Sécurité",
    "del_vols_pers",     "Vols personnes ‰",      "Sécurité",
    "del_degradations",  "Dégradations ‰",        "Sécurité",
    "del_trafic_stup",   "Trafic stup. ‰",        "Sécurité",
    "fin_recettes",      "Recettes €/hab",        "Finances",
    "fin_charges",       "Charges €/hab",         "Finances",
    "fin_dette",         "Dette €/hab",           "Finances",
    "fin_caf",           "CAF €/hab",             "Finances",
    "fin_taux_taxe_hab", "Taxe habitation %",     "Finances",
    "fin_taux_fonc_bati","Foncier bâti %",        "Finances",
    "apl_medecins",      "APL médecins",          "Santé",
    "apl_medecins_jeunes","APL médecins ≤65",     "Santé",
    "apl_infirmieres",   "APL infirmières",       "Santé",
    "apl_sagefemmes",    "APL sages-femmes",      "Santé",
    "apl_dentistes",     "APL dentistes",         "Santé",
    "apl_kines",         "APL kinésithérapeutes", "Santé",
    "defm_taux_pop",     "Chômage ‰",             "Chômage",
    "acc_taux_pop",      "Accidents BAAC ‰",      "Sécurité",
    "densite_rang",      "Densité INSEE (1=rural→6=urbain)", "Démographie",
    "carb_hab_total",    "Empreinte CO₂ (t/hab)", "Énergie",
    "mob_pct_emploi_local", "% emploi local",     "Mobilité",
    "mob_pct_voiture",   "% voiture",             "Mobilité",
    "mob_pct_tc",        "% TC",                  "Mobilité",
    "mob_pct_velo",      "% vélo",                "Mobilité",
    "bio_surface_ha",    "Surface bio (ha)",      "Agriculture",
    "bio_n_exploit",     "Nb exploitations bio",  "Agriculture",
    "bio_n_operateurs",  "Nb opérateurs bio",     "Agriculture"
  )
  # Garde uniquement les colonnes effectivement dans merged
  biv_vars <- biv_vars[biv_vars$field %in% names(merged), ]

  # Slim data pour le JS : 1 ligne par commune avec valeurs arrondies
  biv_payload <- merged |>
    dplyr::select(code = code_commune,
                  dplyr::any_of(biv_vars$field)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(-code,
                                ~ ifelse(is.na(.) | !is.finite(.), NA_real_,
                                         round(., 3))))

  biv_data_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(biv_payload, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null",
                                    digits = 3)
  biv_vars_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(biv_vars, auto_unbox = TRUE)
  palette_js    <- jsonlite::toJSON(biv_palette)

  cat('<script>\n',
      'window.bivPalette = ', as.character(palette_js), ';\n',
      'window.bivVarMeta = ', as.character(biv_vars_json), ';\n',
      'window.bivData    = ', as.character(biv_data_json), ';\n',
      '\n',
      '// Construit les 2 dropdowns groupés par thématique\n',
      'window.bivBuildSelectors = function() {\n',
      '  var groups = {};\n',
      '  window.bivVarMeta.forEach(function(v) {\n',
      '    if (!groups[v.group]) groups[v.group] = [];\n',
      '    groups[v.group].push(v);\n',
      '  });\n',
      '  function buildSelect(id, defaultField) {\n',
      '    var sel = document.getElementById(id);\n',
      '    if (!sel || sel._built) return;\n',
      '    sel.innerHTML = "";\n',
      '    Object.keys(groups).forEach(function(g) {\n',
      '      var og = document.createElement("optgroup"); og.label = g;\n',
      '      groups[g].forEach(function(v) {\n',
      '        var o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = v.field; o.textContent = v.label;\n',
      '        if (v.field === defaultField) o.selected = true;\n',
      '        og.appendChild(o);\n',
      '      });\n',
      '      sel.appendChild(og);\n',
      '    });\n',
      '    sel.addEventListener("change", window.bivRecompute);\n',
      '    sel._built = true;\n',
      '  }\n',
      '  buildSelect("biv-x", "elec_pct_rn");\n',
      '  buildSelect("biv-y", "dvf_prix_app");\n',
      '};\n',
      '\n',
      '// Calcule les terciles X et Y et recolore les polygones\n',
      'window.bivRecompute = function() {\n',
      '  var xSel = document.getElementById("biv-x");\n',
      '  var ySel = document.getElementById("biv-y");\n',
      '  if (!xSel || !ySel || !window.bivMap) return;\n',
      '  var xVar = xSel.value, yVar = ySel.value;\n',
      '  if (!xVar || !yVar) return;\n',
      '  // Sous-ensemble des communes avec X et Y non-NA\n',
      '  var valid = window.bivData.filter(function(r) { return r[xVar] != null && r[yVar] != null; });\n',
      '  if (valid.length < 30) {\n',
      '    document.getElementById("biv-status").textContent = "⚠ Pas assez de communes (" + valid.length + ") pour cette paire";\n',
      '    return;\n',
      '  }\n',
      '  var xs = valid.map(function(r){return r[xVar];}).sort(function(a,b){return a-b;});\n',
      '  var ys = valid.map(function(r){return r[yVar];}).sort(function(a,b){return a-b;});\n',
      '  var n  = xs.length;\n',
      '  var xT1 = xs[Math.floor(n/3)], xT2 = xs[Math.floor(2*n/3)];\n',
      '  var yT1 = ys[Math.floor(n/3)], yT2 = ys[Math.floor(2*n/3)];\n',
      '  // Classe par commune\n',
      '  var classes = {};\n',
      '  valid.forEach(function(r) {\n',
      '    var xb = r[xVar] < xT1 ? 1 : (r[xVar] < xT2 ? 2 : 3);\n',
      '    var yb = r[yVar] < yT1 ? 1 : (r[yVar] < yT2 ? 2 : 3);\n',
      '    classes[r.code] = (yb - 1) * 3 + xb;\n',
      '  });\n',
      '  // Recolore la carte\n',
      '  window.bivMap.eachLayer(function(layer) {\n',
      '    if (!layer.options || !layer.options.layerId) return;\n',
      '    var cl = classes[layer.options.layerId];\n',
      '    if (cl) layer.setStyle({ fillColor: window.bivPalette[cl-1], fillOpacity: 0.85 });\n',
      '    else   layer.setStyle({ fillColor: "#E8E4DC", fillOpacity: 0.20 });\n',
      '  });\n',
      '  // Status\n',
      '  document.getElementById("biv-status").textContent = valid.length + " communes croisées sur " + window.bivData.length;\n',
      '  // Légende\n',
      '  var xlbl = window.bivVarMeta.find(function(v){return v.field===xVar;}).label;\n',
      '  var ylbl = window.bivVarMeta.find(function(v){return v.field===yVar;}).label;\n',
      '  var html = "<div class=\\"biv-legend\\"><div class=\\"biv-legend-title\\">Terciles croisés</div><div class=\\"biv-grid-wrap\\"><div class=\\"biv-yarrow\\">↑ " + ylbl + "</div><div class=\\"biv-grid\\">";\n',
      '  for (var by = 3; by >= 1; by--) {\n',
      '    for (var bx = 1; bx <= 3; bx++) {\n',
      '      var cl = (by-1)*3 + bx;\n',
      '      html += "<div class=\\"biv-cell\\" style=\\"background:" + window.bivPalette[cl-1] + "\\"></div>";\n',
      '    }\n',
      '  }\n',
      '  html += "</div></div><div class=\\"biv-xarrow\\">" + xlbl + " →</div></div>";\n',
      '  document.getElementById("biv-legend").innerHTML = html;\n',
      '};\n',
      '</script>\n',
      sep = ""
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: map-bivariate
if (explorer_ready) {
  m <- leaflet::leaflet(
    com_metro_only,
    options = leaflet::leafletOptions(
      preferCanvas       = TRUE,
      zoomControl        = TRUE,
      attributionControl = FALSE,
      minZoom            = 4, maxZoom = 12
    )
  ) |>
    .fit_to_sf(com_metro_only, padding = c(20, 20)) |>
    leaflet::addPolygons(
      data = com_metro_only,
      fillColor    = "#E8E4DC",
      fillOpacity  = 0.3,
      color        = "#FFFFFF",
      weight       = 0.1,
      opacity      = 0.4,
      smoothFactor = 0.4,
      layerId      = com_metro_only$code
    ) |>
    leaflet::addPolygons(
      data         = dep_metro,
      fill         = FALSE,
      color        = "#1A1A1A",
      weight       = 0.6,
      opacity      = 0.55,
      smoothFactor = 0.4,
      options      = leaflet::pathOptions(interactive = FALSE)
    ) |>
    .add_resize_handler() |>
    htmlwidgets::onRender(
      "function(el, x) {
         window.bivMap = this;
         setTimeout(function() {
           if (window.bivBuildSelectors) window.bivBuildSelectors();
           if (window.bivRecompute)     window.bivRecompute();
         }, 200);
       }"
    )
  m
}
```
